expected.title: Locally Lipschitz construction of rapidly decreasing character models from generator brackets for concrete regularity structures satisfying assumptions A through C
expected.author: Ismael Bailleul; Masato Hoshino
expected.difficulty_reason: The standard reconstruction and paraproduct estimates do not construct all positive-sector character coordinates from arbitrary generator brackets. The author introduces an intermediate negative-homogeneity regularity structure and then proves the derivative and two-point character bounds by a two-scale dyadic Taylor-remainder induction. Those uniform rapidly decreasing estimates close the algebraic extension and local Lipschitz construction rather than assuming an existing model.
